create.title: Create a new site
create.subtitle: Three steps: pick a theme, tell us about yourself, look and save. Nothing is written before Save.
create.search: Search the themes in your own words…
create.noMatchHint: Try other words, or pick the closest theme — every text can be changed later.
create.other.title: Something else
create.other.subtitle: Describe your site in a few words — we suggest the closest theme.
create.other.describe: Describe your site in a few words…
create.other.hint: The closest themes come first. Every text, colour and section can be changed later.
create.f.name: Name of the site, business or person
create.f.offerHint: One or two sentences in your own words; they become the first text visitors read.
create.f.offerPh: I help people take their next step without the stress.
create.f.audienceHint: A short line, e.g. “for people at a crossroads”.
create.f.servicesHint: Up to eight. Anything missing is left out, never invented.
create.f.contactsHint: They go into the contact section and every “Call” or “Write” button.
create.f.schemeHint: Auto follows the visitor’s system: your colours by day, a matching dark look at night.
create.f.photosHint: The first one goes into the first screen, the rest into the gallery. Without photos the site gets illustrations in its colours.
create.f.folderHint: The site is created in a new folder inside it, with Git and one first commit.
create.ai.hint: Three steps — plan, write, check — in your language, from what you typed. Nothing invented. About {min}–{max} credits per site.
create.ai.needs: Needs a plan or your own Anthropic key (Settings). Without it the theme’s sample texts are used with your details.
create.preview.hint: Click through the pages — this is the finished site.
create.preview.label: Preview of the site
create.done.title: {name} is created
create.done.files: {n} files, ready for visitors — SEO, 404, privacy page, sitemap
create.done.git: Git with one first commit; every later change is one commit you can undo
create.done.noGit: Git was not found — changes are kept, but without history
create.done.notPublished: Nothing is published until you say so
create.edit.title: Change it with words
create.edit.subtitle: Say what to change; the site is rebuilt and the change saved.
create.edit.placeholder: e.g. make it darker · remove the reviews · add a section with prices
create.edit.costHint: Colours, styles, dark mode, removing a section and a new title are free; other requests use the AI (≈ {min}–{max} credits).
create.edit.localOnly: Without a plan or an AI key: colours, styles, dark mode, removing a section and a new title in quotes.
create.edit.ex.title: change the title to "…"
create.noFake: We never invent reviews, customers, addresses or results. Missing data is left out.
style.bold.hint: Energy, big type, one bright accent
err.noCredits: You are out of AI credits. They renew with your plan, or add a credit pack from Plan & usage. The sample texts still work without AI.
err.creditsLater: Your included credits are released gradually and not enough is released yet. This can start at {at}; a credit pack works now.
err.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet, VPN or proxy and try again — the app keeps working offline; only the AI texts need the network.
err.timeout: The AI did not answer in time. Nothing was charged for what did not arrive; try again in a minute.
err.notLoggedIn: Sign in to use the built-in AI, or add your own Anthropic key in Settings.
err.aiUnavailable: The built-in AI needs a plan or your own Anthropic key (Settings). The sample texts work without it.
err.rateLimited: Too many AI requests at once. Wait a minute and try again.
err.cloudMissing: The cloud is not set up for this account yet ({detail}). The owner deploys it with the cloud-deploy workflow.
err.exists: A folder with this name already exists there. Pick another name or folder.
err.handEdited: Some files were edited by hand since the site was made, so this change was not written over them.
err.noEngine: Creating and changing sites runs on the engine inside the desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux). Download it and open this page there.
